title: Quantization-Induced Reasoning Drift: Experiment Artifacts (Pre-Registered N=500 Null Result)
description:
Complete artifacts for a pre-registered controlled experiment testing whether RL post-training on top of distillation changes quantization-induced chain-of-thought inflation, relative to pure distillation, at matched 3-bit quantization.

Headline: the pre-registered primary endpoint is a NULL (paired token-inflation difference −412 tokens, 95% bootstrap CI [−997, +115]), with sign opposite to the hypothesis and to an earlier 50-problem pilot. The co-primary endpoint (loop rate) is large (0.598 vs 0.348, z=8.2) but definition-dependent: it vanishes under a stricter prior loop definition (Pipis et al., arXiv:2512.12895).

Contents: pre-registration (PLAN.md, written before Round-2 execution), generation/analysis scripts, and 2,200 raw per-generation JSONL records (200 pilot + 2,000 Round-2) across DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B (pure SFT distillation) and DeepScaleR-1.5B-Preview (same base + RL), each at BF16 and 3-bit MLX group quantization, on all 500 MATH-500 problems.

Code: MIT license. Data (results_pilot/, results_round2/): CC BY 4.0. Problem statements are not redistributed; load from HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500.
notes: Companion paper (survey + this experiment) archived separately on Zenodo as a preprint deposit; DOI to be added here once minted.
